---
name: Bounded improvement or documentation task
about: Propose a small synthetic-only usability, code-quality or reproducibility change
title: "[Improvement] "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

### User/reviewer problem
Describe the specific observable user pain, preferably with an exact
existing source/doc link. Do not claim an actual researcher interview
or verified live browser result without evidence.

### Existing issue and dependency search
Link prior open/closed issues checked. Avoid duplication of broad v0
generator, rights, grouped split, baseline and manifest issues.

### In scope and out of scope
- Proposed narrow files / functions:
- Scientific, privacy or license invariants to preserve:
- Out of scope: real/human/clinical data, releases, new hosting, live
  performance claims, changing prespecified model or test labels.

### Definition of done
- [ ] Focused source/documentation change with exact committed SHA
- [ ] Specific meaningful negative/edge/reproducibility test, as applicable
- [ ] Source docs cross-linked with honest scientific limits
- [ ] Exact current SHA hosted test proof OR **NOT RUN / BLOCKED** status
- [ ] Independent reviewer disposition; no self-approved merge

### Scope/feasibility estimate
State why a first-time contributor with **existing private access** can
finish independently, or mark **NOT GOOD FIRST ISSUE** when blocked by
host permission, statistical design or real privacy/security verification.

### Permissions
Creating a private issue does not authorize public PRs, outreach, publication,
third-party hosting, billing or changes to repository visibility.
